newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Further weakness in boxed beef and larger fed cattle supplies ahead.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to up 0.100 cent. Higher CME index and lower corn futures indication.
LEAN HOGS - Off 0.250 to up 0.100 cent. Technically weak and packers cutting kills, but runs lighter than expected.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.250 to up 0.250 cent. Technically weak but light hog slaughter, strong cash market supportive.
